caption:
The top shelf

Cella got the top shelf down for her.

Reaching from the floor with your weight over your feet is steadier than balancing on a chair.

For the friend who gets the top shelf for everyone.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A kitchen with a high shelf and a container on it. A royal blue figure on the right stretches up toward it and trembles, again and again, but cannot reach. A small ink-black figure with white eyes walks over, stretches tall, and the container comes down to the floor in front of the blue one. Both turn happy with a pulse.
